posts.text: I spent way too much of my childhood on Minecraft... So I rebuilt my portfolio around that nostalgia. Three worlds you can switch between, a chatbot trained on me, a crafting table that crafts my resume, and a server-list style projects page. All in "vanilla" HTML, CSS, and JS. There's also a hidden fourth world if you poke around long enough (my chatbot might know something about it 🤔). There's so much to explore, link in the comments!!

We just won second place overall at Canada’s “stupidest” hackathon. At the Stupid Ideas Hackathon: Toronto Edition, together with Jeremy Liu and Jeffrey Wong, we built Chud GO!: a game that lets you capture and battle your friends like Pokémon. Check it out in the comments below! Huge thanks to Smit P., Kallie Zhang and the team for putting together such a unique event — the prize money paid for my dinner 😋 Onto the next challenge 🔥
